This editorial illustration for Tempo magazine features a light beige background. At the top, the green word "TEMPO" is flanked by two headlines: "SKANDAL PEMERKOSAAN PUTRA ALTAR" and "LOBI PARTAI BANTENG DI RUU PANCASILA". Below the masthead, two men with caricatured features and tan jackets are depicted. The man on the left, with dark hair and a darker shirt, is shown from the torso up, looking forward. The man on the right, wearing glasses, leans forward with his hands outstretched as if balancing.

They stand atop a large, green, segmented logo shape composed of horizontal bars that form a stylized "B". On the right, a hand in a dark sleeve with a yellow symbol resembling a stylized "kb" is pulling one of the green bars away from the central structure.

Large black text to the right reads "PALAGAN BOSOWA DI BANK BUKOPIN" followed by a paragraph of smaller text. The bottom left corner contains publication details including "22-28 JUNI 2020", price, website, ISSN, a barcode, and the number "00018". A QR code is in the bottom right corner.
